title: Cal. Gov. Code § 12955 source-of-income, income and credit screening protections
requirement: Landlords may not discriminate based on source of income (including Section 8 vouchers), may not use income standards that disregard a subsidized tenant's actual rent share, and must let applicants substitute alternative proof of ability to pay for credit history.
coverage_conditions: Applies to owners of any housing accommodation and to the rental of housing in California.
exemptions: Verifying employment, requesting landlord references, and verifying identity remain permitted; inquiring about income level or source is not source-of-income discrimination.
quoted_span: (o) (1) In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy, to do either of the following: (A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
